title: Ivan the Terrible's Descent into Madness
description: In Ilya Repin's haunting portrait, Ivan the Terrible's turmoil is palpable. His son's lifeless gaze seems to beg for forgiveness, while Ivan's own hand trembles in regret. Artwork: Ilya Repin (https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Iván_el_Terrible_y_su_hijo,_por_Iliá_Repin.jpg)
